summary: Comprehensive testing of 2FA enforcement features. All 13 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend code review confirms all required components are implemented correctly. Admin user (admkoodh@koodh.com) has 2FA enabled so force_2fa=false for them (expected). Email backup codes endpoint returns 503 when SMTP not configured (expected in preview).

issues: Minor: Console warnings about DialogContent missing DialogTitle for accessibility - not blocking functionality

Login_force_2fa_field.details: POST /api/auth/login returns force_2fa=false for admin with 2FA enabled (correct behavior)

Auth_me_force_2fa_field.details: GET /api/auth/me returns force_2fa, totp_enabled, totp_skip_count fields

Enforcement_status_endpoint.details: GET /api/auth/2fa/enforcement-status returns force_2fa, totp_enabled, totp_skip_count, skips_remaining

Skip_2fa_endpoint.details: POST /api/auth/2fa/skip increments skip count, returns 400 when max (3) reached

Email_backup_codes_endpoint.details: POST /api/auth/2fa/email-backup-codes returns 503 when SMTP not configured (expected in preview), 400 for empty codes

Main_site_require_2fa_field.details: GET/PUT /api/main-sites returns and accepts require_2fa boolean field

Frontend_TwoFactorEnforcementWrapper.details: App.js correctly checks user.force_2fa before showing TwoFactorEnforcement dialog

Frontend_TwoFactorSetup_buttons.details: TwoFactorSetup.js has Download (data-testid='download-codes-btn'), Email (data-testid='email-codes-btn'), Copy (data-testid='copy-all-codes-btn') buttons

Frontend_EditMainSiteWizard_toggle.details: EditMainSiteWizard.js has Require 2FA toggle (data-testid='require-2fa-toggle') that updates require_2fa field

Frontend_AuthContext_force_2fa.details: AuthContext.js extracts force_2fa from login response and passes to user object

critical_code_review_comments: check_user_requires_2fa() correctly checks is_network_admin and main_site.require_2fa
Skip endpoint uses max(0, count) to handle negative skip counts (mentioned in context)
Email backup codes endpoint properly returns 503 when SMTP not configured
Frontend TwoFactorEnforcementWrapper only shows when user.force_2fa=true AND totp_enabled=false
context_for_next_testing_agent: 2FA enforcement features fully implemented and tested. Admin user has 2FA enabled so force_2fa=false for them. The enforcement popup only shows for users where force_2fa=true AND totp_enabled=false. Email backup codes returns 503 in preview (SMTP not configured). All backend endpoints working correctly. Frontend components have proper data-testid attributes for testing.
